term_note: Barangay and SK officials elected in the October 30, 2023 BSKE are still serving in October 2026. RA 12232 (signed August 2025) first moved the BSKE from December 2025 to November 2, 2026; then RA 12326, signed September 24, 2026, cancelled the November 2026 polls, set the next BSKE for the second Monday of November 2028 (November 13, 2028), and fixed barangay/SK terms at five years, so 2023-elected officials keep their posts until then. Comelec cancelled 2026 BSKE activities on September 25, 2026; petitions against the law are pending before the Supreme Court (not junked as of Oct 13, 2026).
general_notes: pasigcity.gov.ph pages (incl. the Nov 17, 2023 oath-taking release) could not be fetched (robots disallowed); not worked around.
All barangay officials come from barangaydirectory.com (aggregator, '2023 - 2026 term'); no official per-barangay list was reachable, so every barangay value is verify:true.
Pasig City Hall operates from a Temporary City Hall at Bridgetowne, E. Amang Rodriguez Ave., Rosario; new city hall expected 2027 (Philstar 2026-08-03).
City trunkline (02) 8643-1111 confirmed in multiple 2025 charters; city hotline (02) 8643-0000.

Ex-officio councilors conflict: officials.json (Oct 19) listed Marl Oscar de Guzman and Georgia Lynne P. Clemente; Wikipedia (Oct 21) lists Rigor J. Enriquez (Liga) and Keil P. Custillas (SK Federation). Directory shows the latter; both unconfirmed.
